resolutions.researcher_notes: Old ref (argaam.com/ar/.../1058075) actually resolves fine now (url_verifier OK, 200, content present) — brief's DEAD_LINK flag appears stale/transient; content check confirms Argaam's article is a verbatim republish of an Al-Shorouk (bawabat al-Shorouk) news report dated 2014-10-03, citing an Egyptian Petroleum Ministry report from GASCO chairman Karam Mahmoud to Minister Sherif Ismail: 'انتهى قطاع البترول من تنفيذ خطي أنابيب نقل الغاز الطبيعى «النوبارية – السادات» وإدفو' ('the petroleum sector has completed construction of the Nubariya-Sadat and Edfu natural-gas transmission pipelines') — 'تم الانتهاء من تنفيذ خط غاز إدفو ... لتوصيل الغاز الطبيعى لمصنعي السكر والورق، بالإضافة إلى المنازل بمدينة إدفو' (completed, to supply sugar/paper factories and homes in Edfu). Construction-completion + gas-delivery language directly supports Status=operating (status is inferable from context per SOP, not a literal token). Switched the cited ref to the original outlet (shorouknews.com) rather than Argaam's republish, since Argaam explicitly attributes the story to Al-Shorouk — the two are NOT independent (same original report), so this is treated as a single strong primary source, not 2 independent corroborations. Searched for an unrelated independent second source (emiratesvoice.com aggregator, Youm7, Al-Ahram, EgyptOil&Gas, presidency.eg) but every hit either traces to the same 2014-10-03 Shorouk/Ministry report or covers unrelated later Edfu-area gas work (2021-2025 village distribution extensions, a 2025 pipeline fire) — no independent corroboration of this specific 2014 completion found. No contradiction to flag.

Same Al-Shorouk 2014-10-03 article gives exact segment specs: 'تم الانتهاء من تنفيذ خط غاز إدفو بطول 37 كم وقطر 12 بوصة باستثمارات 95 مليون جنيه' ('the Edfu gas line, 37 km long and 12 inches in diameter, at a cost of EGP 95 million, was completed') — url_verifier confirms this exact phrase present (OK, contains_value=true). Matches GEM's Diameter=12/DiameterUnits=in exactly. Same source as Status ref (Argaam's republish carries identical text, verified separately at https://www.argaam.com/ar/article/articledetail/id/1058075 for cross-check but not cited as a second independent source — see Status notes). No independent second source located for the specific diameter figure despite targeted Arabic searches ('إدفو' + '12 بوصة' / '37 كم'); tier held at medium (1 strong primary/government-sourced report). No contradiction found.

Same Al-Shorouk article: '...باستثمارات 95 مليون جنيه' for the Edfu line specifically (distinct from the co-reported Nubariya-Sadat line's EGP 495m — the two must not be conflated; combined project cost for both lines is EGP 590m per the headline, but the Edfu-specific figure is 95m, matching GEM's SegmentCost=95,000,000/EGP). url_verifier's automated substring screen on this exact URL returned a false-negative FAIL for the cost phrase (likely an Arabic text-normalization/whitespace artifact in the folding step) — manually re-fetched the page with the same requests/UA the verifier uses and confirmed the exact string 'باستثمارات 95 مليون جنيه' is present in the parsed body immediately after 'خط غاز إدفو بطول 37 كم وقطر 12 بوصة'; recording contains_value=true on that basis (per url_verifier.py's own guidance that a substring-screen FAIL is a screen, not the verdict, and the agent must read the page). No independent second source found for the cost figure specifically. No contradiction found.

Two independent-origin sources: (1) the Al-Shorouk 2014 article names 'كارم محمود، رئيس شركة «جاسكو» المُشغل الرئيسى للشبكة القومية للغازات الطبيعية' (Karam Mahmoud, chairman of 'GASCO', the main operator of the national natural-gas network) as the one reporting completion of the Edfu line up the ministry chain — establishing GASCO's operating role over this network segment. (2) GASCO's own official site states verbatim 'The Egyptian Natural Gas Company (GASCO) was established in March 1997 ... and Since that date GASCO started practicing its activities in the field of transporting, distributing, supplying, processing of natural gas' — confirming 'Egyptian Natural Gas Co' as GASCO's correct official English name/entity, matching GEM's Operator field exactly. Caveat: url_verifier FAILs on https://www.gasco.com.eg/ (and https://gasco.com.eg/) with a Python/requests SSLError ('unable to get local issuer certificate') — a documented false-negative class per url_verifier.py's own docstring (SSL cert-chain errors on some .eg sites); manually confirmed live and content-matching via curl (200, ~3.6k chars of body text after script/style stripping, containing the exact 'Egyptian Natural Gas Company (GASCO) was established in March 1997' sentence). Tried the /index.php/about-us/ subpage as an alternative but it 404s ('Page not found') under the site's routing, so cited the homepage instead, which carries the same company-identity text. Neither source names Edfu by segment explicitly in the operator-identity sentence, so tier held at medium rather than high despite 2 independent origins — the specific claim 'GASCO operates the Edfu segment' rests on source (1) alone; source (2) only corroborates the entity-name match. No contradiction found.
